sanitizer_environment: Requires access to process maps. The restricted sandbox caused sanitizer infrastructure failures also reproduced by an independent trivial exception program; the full test binary passed with that restriction removed.
notes: The arithmetic JIT executes generated x86_64 machine code on the validation host.
ARM64 validation checks opcodes and relative literal offsets; it does not establish Android executable-memory permission or device behavior.
The source LUT loader validates sizes, invalid payloads and D6 invariance; source SHA256 provenance is checked by tools/import_lognet.py.
Memory selection is lexical and bounded by content bytes, not model tokenization.
Route selection does not execute network or model operations.
